05 FAQ

Before we begin

Useful answers,
up front.

Who do you work with?+

Homeowners, interior designers, contractors, modular furniture businesses, students, and professionals who need focused technical support.

Can you support projects remotely?+

Yes. Online technical consultancy can support projects across India. Site-dependent services and on-site consultancy are scoped according to location and availability.

What information should I share first?+

Your city, property or project type, approximate area, current stage, key challenge, desired service, and target timeline are enough for an initial discussion.

How is a service priced?+

Fees depend on the chosen service, project size, location, number of modules, review stage, and deliverables. A clear quote is shared after the scope is understood.
